$comment: release/bh-trial-2 ownership map (bh-quality plan, W0.4). `paths` maps a repo path or glob to the ONE workstream that may change it on its branch (from the plan's 'Files owned' lists; W0 = foundation, changed after bh2-base only through a W0 follow-up PR by the integrator). Anything not mapped belongs to the integrator. Enforced by scripts/medreport/ownership-guard.mjs (rules in `rules`); checked by scripts/medreport/ownership-guard.test.ts. Only the integrator edits this file. Globs: `*` = within one path segment, `**` = any depth.

base.note: Workstream branches start at tag bh2-base2 (bh2-base + the W0 follow-up: the remaining shared definitions and the seams below); until it exists the guard diffs against the merge base with origin/release/bh-trial-2.

W0.title: Foundation: base, safety corpus and gates, schema expansion, module split, tokenizer, shared types

fixBranches.note: Verification fix branches ws/bh2-fix<N>-<owner>[-<topic>] get the map of <owner> (a workstream alias, e.g. ws/bh2-fix1-wb, ws/bh2-fix2-review-labels).

forbidden.why: third-party templates and maps (Dell's) and fictional replay data stay gitignored – never committed

rules.owned: A workstream may add, change, rename or delete the paths mapped to it.
rules.tests: Any workstream may ADD a new test file (*.test.ts, *.test.tsx, *.test.mjs) anywhere. In an existing test file it does not own it may only add lines (0 deleted lines); a changed or removed expectation there needs an integrator grant and is listed with its reason (DoC-1 C1).
rules.corpus: Corpus cases (__corpus__/cases/*.jsonl) and fixtures are append-only for every workstream: new files and added lines only. safety-corpus.lock.json takes new entries only (node scripts/medreport/corpus-lock.mjs --add, in the commit that adds the case); corpus-guard.mjs <base>, run by the integrator at every merge, refuses a changed or removed entry. Only the integrator edits pending.json, the allowlist and retired.json (retired rows: append-only, each with its decision and superseding cases).
rules.crossCutting: A cross-cutting path may be changed by its owner in `paths` or by a workstream named in the entry's wiredBy, and the change must keep the entry's rule.
rules.grants: The integrator may grant one path to one workstream for one branch in `grants` (path, workstream, branch, reason). Grants are the only way to touch another workstream's or the integrator's file.
rules.default: Everything else – any unmapped path, another workstream's path, an integrator-only path – is refused. W0 and WI branches are exempt.

crossCutting.since: 6d897da (merge of feat/reuse-notes 5d92879, Khuram's decision 26/10: ships with this release)
crossCutting.rule: A report made from an earlier report's notes ("Complete another form for this patient") goes through the same report factory as a new one (generate.ts createTargetReport -> core/report-factory.ts createFormReport / createReport) and gets everything a new report gets: the approver (W0.6 plumbing, WC picker), conditions frozen at creation in section.condition and the issue state (WA1), and model 2 (Report.reportModel = REPORT_MODEL, set by the report factory since bh2-base – W0.6). No reuse-only creation path. The reuse endpoint stays tenant-scoped (the clinic's own store, id only) and consent is never carried over (core/reuse.ts recordForAnotherForm).
